# Frank Penney Injury Law

> California personal injury law firm representing accident victims across Northern
> California and statewide. Over $1 billion recovered and more than 30 years of
> experience. Free consultation; no fee unless we win.

Headquarters: 1508 Eureka Rd, Roseville, CA 95661
Phone: 1-888-888-0566
Contact: https://penneylaw.com/contact

Nothing on this site is legal advice, and reading it does not create an
attorney-client relationship. Case results depend on the facts of each case and
past results do not guarantee a similar outcome.

## Practice Areas

- [Personal Injury](https://penneylaw.com/personal-injury): General California personal injury representation.
- [Car Accidents](https://penneylaw.com/car-accidents): California car and auto collision claims.
- [Truck Accidents](https://penneylaw.com/truck-accidents): Commercial truck and semi-truck crash claims, including FMCSA and ELD evidence.
- [Motorcycle Accidents](https://penneylaw.com/motorcycle-accidents): Motorcycle crash claims, including lane-splitting and helmet-law questions.
- [Bicycle Accidents](https://penneylaw.com/bicycle-accidents): Cyclist injury claims.
- [Pedestrian Accidents](https://penneylaw.com/pedestrian-accidents): Crosswalk and pedestrian right-of-way claims.
- [Bus Accidents](https://penneylaw.com/bus-accidents): Public transit and private bus injury claims.
- [Slip and Fall](https://penneylaw.com/slip-and-fall): California premises liability claims.
- [Dog Bite](https://penneylaw.com/dog-bite): Dog bite claims under California's strict liability statute.
- [Wrongful Death](https://penneylaw.com/wrongful-death): Wrongful death claims for surviving family members.
- [Traumatic Brain Injuries](https://penneylaw.com/traumatic-brain-injuries): TBI and head injury claims.

## Legal Guides and Resources

- [Resources](https://penneylaw.com/resources): Index of all guides, injury types, and accident scenarios.
- [How Much Is My Case Worth](https://penneylaw.com/how-much-is-my-case-worth): Case value guide plus an interactive estimate tool.
- [Personal Injury Claim Process](https://penneylaw.com/personal-injury-claim-process): Step-by-step walkthrough of a California claim.
- [Uninsured Motorist Accidents](https://penneylaw.com/uninsured-motorist-accidents): UM/UIM coverage under Ins. Code § 11580.2.
- [Attorney Referrals](https://penneylaw.com/attorney-referrals): Co-counsel and referral information for other attorneys.

### Social Media and Online Platform Harm

- [Social Media Addiction Lawsuits](https://penneylaw.com/social-media-addiction-lawsuit): Claims over Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, Snapchat and YouTube; MDL 3047 (N.D. Cal.) and JCCP 5255 (Los Angeles). Screening criteria, records needed, and no settlement figures because none exist yet.
- [Roblox Child Exploitation Lawsuits](https://penneylaw.com/roblox-child-exploitation-lawsuit): Grooming and sexual exploitation that began on Roblox; MDL 3166 (N.D. Cal.). Eligibility turns on the initial contact occurring on the platform. Adult survivors of childhood abuse included; CCP § 340.1.
